desc: Ideation: identify monotone binary search, base sweep endpoint p, extra edge-pair cover, and MWIS dual.
Implement feasible(x) with O(n) prefix/suffix MWIS DP as specified in NEXT.
Implement maxScore binary search with high bound and edge cases (x=0, m<n, req>m).
Test examples, n=2, m<n, large m/points, and brute-force random small n/m to validate feasible(x), and report a clear SAMPLE TESTS PASS/FAIL verdict.
